blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Most of the Visayas will experience generally fair weather at the start of the week, although rain showers remain possible due to the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ), while warm and humid conditions are expected to persist, the state weather bureau said. In its forecast for Monday, November 23, Pagasa said Eastern Visayas will have cloudy skies with scattered rain showers and thunderstorms due to the ITCZ. The rest of the Visayas, along with Occidental Mindoro and Palawan, including the Kalayaan Islands, will experience generally fair weather, although isolated rain showers or thunderstorms may still occur.
